body:
Asked for by the maintainer (2026-11-13, in chat): "The WCS paget got a real nice makeover, we need to clean up the design on Stock, Machine, Fixtures, Toolist, Setup pages as well.."

What is wanted: the WCS page as it is on main now (its recent tidy-up, e.g. PR 759) is the reference. The same clean-up is owed on five pages:

- Stock
- Machine
- Fixtures
- Tool list
- Setup

Scope per page: the same grouping, spacing, labels, action placement and progressive disclosure the WCS page uses, built from the same shared widgets (no page-private copies). Layout only: no command, parameter or project-file change; every edit still goes through its existing undoable command. Text stays plain English (no G-code standard jargon).

Notes for whoever works it:
- First step is a short comment on this issue listing what the WCS page does that the five do not (the pattern to copy), so the pages end up alike.
- One PR per page (or per page family), so each can be looked at on its own. Each PR carries before/after screenshots in its description: the maintainer does not merge a page-look change he cannot see.
- Snapshot PNGs are not changed in a PR; the structural assertions (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs`) are updated instead.
- Related: issue 1122 (pages draw only through the form seam) touches the same pages; check for an open PR on a page before starting it, and stack or wait rather than conflict.

Done means: each of the five pages follows the WCS page's layout pattern, with its structural test updated and before/after screenshots in its PR; this issue lists the five PRs.
